mostWorthwhile.text: Making silicate grains was the most worthwhile passage: it connected oxygen, silicon and magnesium to rocky minerals condensing from vapor.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated checks that found no available partners were frustrating and did little to clarify the rock-forming route.

surprise.text: I expected cooling the ejecta to make grains directly; instead, they drove a shock into gas, which had to cool and mix with stellar material.

arbitrary.text: The need to return to carbon-rich stellar material and combine it with neutral helium was not obvious to me while searching for dust; inspection revealed the route, and the result explained its purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the mixed dust helps molecules form and eventually contributes to planets, though I would hope for fewer dead-end checks.
